title: The Unwritten
subtitle: Faction · Informal movement · freedom from recorded ownership

fields.label: Aspect
fields.value: No One Owns the Name I Choose

fields.label: Agenda / methods
fields.value: Abolish involuntary time collection. Hide debtors, circulate counterfeit blank forms and stage public readings of erased names.

fields.label: Face / resource
fields.value: Lark, a former obituary writer, knows the city by aliases. Members maintain safe kitchens and unregistered bellwind routes.

fields.label: Internal fault line
fields.value: A rescue wing wants the forged roll exposed; a purist cell wants every debt record destroyed, including evidence that could free innocent collectors.

fields.label: Relationship / price
fields.value: Offers Ira shelter in exchange for protecting a witness. Distrusts Nera's badge but will judge her testimony rather than her uniform.

fields.label: If ignored
fields.value: The purist cell plans to burn the Archive at 00:15, after the special collection bell at 00:10. Its members can be persuaded to preserve or duplicate evidence; their move is not an inevitable event.
